purpose: Explain why the validated PIT-ALPHA-0016 rank beat 98% of random-priority placebo portfolios yet produced weak growth, deep drawdown, high turnover and negative post-2024 persistence.

held_name_churn: new names and removed names per rebalance
turnover_decomposition: transaction-cost attribution by component and year
rank_persistence: entry rank position among eligible assets
probability an entry remains eligible after 1/3/7/14/30 days
probability it remains Top-2 after 1/3/7/14/30 days
rank-score decay and forward asset return over the same horizons
fixed_v1_overlap: fraction of PIT alt exposure in ETH/SOL/BNB
fraction of days PIT Top-2 overlaps fixed V1 alt holdings
performance and turnover conditional on overlap versus non-overlap
tail_loss_attribution: cost versus gross-loss share in drawdowns
capacity_proxy: position notional as fraction of completed-day quote volume at hypothetical $100k and $1m NAV

interpretation_rule.goal: identify the dominant mechanical reason that validated rank information failed to become acceptable portfolio economics
not_allowed: no changing liquidity or age thresholds
no changing rank weights or Top-N
no testing monthly or persistence-controlled targets in this audit
no selecting a future strategy from audit PnL
no recalculating PIT-ALPHA-0016 as if a modified rule were the original result
interpretation_rule.next_experiment_rule: A future low-turnover experiment may be registered only after this audit identifies a specific causal mechanism; it must receive a new experiment ID.
